   405 \text{ pm} = 405 \times 10^{-12} \text{ m} = 405 \times 10^{-10} \text{ cm}

3. In a face-centered cubic unit cell, there are 4 atoms per unit cell.

   \[
   \text{Mass per atom} = \frac{26.98 \text{ g/mol}}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \text{ atoms/mol}}
   \]

5. Calculate the total mass of atoms in the unit cell:
   \[
   \text{Total mass} = 4 \times \text{Mass per atom}
   \]

6. Calculate the density:
   \[
   \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Total mass}}{\text{Volume}}
   \]
